name: Settings
summary: Declare a schema of typed settings; the shared panel renders it — spacing, grouping, sub-settings, help-vs-tooltip and the danger zone are baked in.
lead: You don't BUILD a settings panel — you declare a schema of typed inputs (switch / checkbox / radio / select / range / number / text / …, Shopify-style) and <aha-settings> renders the compliant AhaSlides surface. Every layout rule lives inside the element, so an agent picks the input type and writes the copy — it CANNOT get spacing, hierarchy, help-vs-tooltip, or the danger zone wrong. A settings surface rebuilt by hand is the drift this replaces.

spec.label: Spacing hierarchy (baked)
spec.value: name→help 4 · sub→parent 8 (+24 indent) · between settings 16 · between groups 32 · danger zone 48

spec.label: Group header
spec.value: noun phrase, weight 600 — members stay regular 400

spec.label: Sub-setting
spec.value: dependsOn → hidden when parent is off, else indented + de-emphasised (never disabled)

spec.label: Help vs tooltip
spec.value: help = a must-see consequence line (tertiary #8A8A8A); info = the ? tooltip (dark-navy, question-mark glyph). Never both on one setting.

spec.label: Control per type
spec.value: switch=toggle · checkbox=box · radio=group · select=segmented(≤4 short)/dropdown · range=slider+value · number=field+unit

spec.label: Danger
spec.value: danger:true routes an item to the danger zone (last, 48 gap); an action renders a danger Button (colorError)

spec.label: Separation
spec.value: spacing only — never a divider or a card around plain settings

props.name: schema
props.desc: The declarative schema (JS property, or a child <script type="application/json">). The element renders it.

props.name: values
props.desc: Current values keyed by setting id, seeded from each item's default

props.name: item.type
props.type: switch | checkbox | radio | select | range | number | text | textarea | color | text_alignment | action | header | paragraph
props.desc: Picks the control; header/paragraph are structure/info

props.name: item.id / label
props.desc: Value key + the noun-phrase label (no decorative icon — the element owns glyphs)

props.name: item.info / help
props.desc: info → the ? tooltip; help → an always-visible must-see-consequence line. Never set both.

props.name: item.dependsOn / dependsValue
props.desc: Marks a sub-setting; shown only when the parent id is truthy (or equals dependsValue)

props.name: item.danger
props.desc: Routes the item to the danger zone at the bottom

props.name: item.options / min / max / step / unit
props.desc: Type-specifics: options for select/radio; min/max/step/unit for range/number

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event on any change; action items emit `action` with {id}

whenToUse.when: a single boolean that takes effect immediately
a boolean saved as part of a group, or a consent
one of a small mutually-exclusive set (all options visible)
one of many — 2–4 short options render as a segmented control, more (or long) as a dropdown
a numeric value — range for a bounded slider, number for free entry with a unit
open a group (2–6 settings) or add an informational line — grouping is spacing, never a card
a setting only applies when its parent is on — it hides when the parent is off
a destructive/irreversible action — routed to the danger zone; confirm upstream before executing

opinion.note: Labels are noun phrases ("Progress bar", not "Show progress bar"). Reach for help ONLY when acting without it risks a consequence that's hard to undo — everything else is `info` (the ? tooltip), and most settings need neither. Authoring guidance for the copy lives in parts/settings.guide.md.

codeNote: One zero-dep custom element renders from a typed schema; the settings skill's construction rules (spacing hierarchy, group weights, hidden sub-settings, help-vs-tooltip, control-per-type, danger zone) are baked into its shadow-DOM implementation — an agent consuming it can't violate them. The judge/eval layer and the copy-authoring guide stay in the aha-design skill; the strict build is this element.

selfCheck.label: help line vs ? tooltip, never both

conformance.$about: Measured against the RENDERED shadow-DOM UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
conformance.measure: (function(){var s=document.querySelector('aha-settings').shadowRoot; var g=function(sel,p){var el=s.querySelector(sel); return el?getComputedStyle(el)[p]:null;}; return { headerWeight:g('.ghead','fontWeight'), toggleOn:g('.tgl[aria-checked="true"]','backgroundColor'), helpColor:g('.help','color'), groupGap:g('.group','rowGap') };})()
